summary_md: **0xiang ([@LingxiangAI](https://x.com/LingxiangAI/status/2116098216664129604))** walks through **caveman** (about 116K stars), a skill/proxy that makes Codex and Claude Code answer in terse phrases while keeping code, paths and errors intact, with install, status and per-tool options; it cautions that claimed 65% savings are mostly output-side and suggests an A/B test on the same bug-fix task measuring output tokens and fix rate ([JuliusBrussee/caveman](https://github.com/JuliusBrussee/caveman), [docs](https://docs.caveman.so/caveman)).
